prompt:

Create a true transparent-background RGBA character asset from this exact 1024x1536 input, preserving original canvas size, character position, scale, silhouette, pose, colors, and brush detail as closely as possible.

Preserve these ankles and all toes, don't thin them. Preserve all fabric contours and folds and the relaxed unchanged stance.
REMOVE ONLY the pale lavender-white background, the top-left text "3｜柔和饱满", ground shadow, the LARGE circular gold sun halo and its radial geometric spokes BEHIND the head/body, and isolated floating background sparkles. Note that the SMALL solid sun ornament on the HAT, the SMALL sun BROOCH, and the solid SUN atop the WAND are parts of the character and MUST stay. Large background halo, caption and ground shadow removed; hat, brooch and wand sun emblems remain. AI extraction is not certified pixel-identical; fine edge/brush-color differences remain possible.
